g.text: Calibration / cost scatter: 3 contexts, 2 independent seeds
Standalone x values are saved offline cost attributions; actual shared setup was paid once in the ledger. Coincident points use nested markers, without jitter.
Minimum shown d_cal=19.912259 > 1. Scatter only: no fitted frontier, qualified-witness or end-to-end speedup claim; two seeds do not establish algorithmic advantage.
